observation_geometry_admission.requirement: every complete nonzero open and hardwood row closes

longwave.admission: observation geometry admitted and B/L full-duration paired
longwave.hardwood_efficacy: L hardwood mean absolute observed depth error < B hardwood
longwave.open_noninferiority: L open mean absolute observed depth error <= B open
longwave.result: PASS only when all predicates hold; otherwise FAIL; failed admission is NOT_EVALUABLE

sublimation.admission: observation geometry admitted and B/S full-duration paired
sublimation.hardwood_efficacy: S hardwood mean absolute observed depth error < B hardwood
sublimation.open_noninferiority: S open mean absolute observed depth error <= B open
sublimation.closure: maximum latent identity residual <= 1e-6 J m^-2 and mass residual <= 1e-12 m
sublimation.result: PASS only when all predicates hold; otherwise FAIL; failed admission is NOT_EVALUABLE

combined_interaction.admission: observation geometry admitted; all four models full-duration paired; longwave and sublimation PASS
combined_interaction.noncompensation: LS hardwood mean absolute observed depth error <= min(L hardwood, S hardwood) and LS open <= B open
combined_interaction.result: PASS only when all predicates hold; otherwise FAIL; failed admission is NOT_EVALUABLE

note: These are diagnostic admission screens only; a PASS would still require a separately authorized promotion package.
